seo.title: ODDference 2027 — Business Conference Powered by Creative Expertise
seo.description: ODDference is a business conference powered by creative expertise — bringing business leaders, founders and decision-makers together with people from culture, design, media, music, games and more. Helsinki, 2027.

title: Where creative expertise meets business and society.

concept.headline: What can business and the rest of society learn from creative expertise?
concept.body:
ODDference is a business conference built around creative and cultural expertise. People who work in art, design, music, film, games and media think constantly about attention, experience, meaning, emotion and how to make something that did not exist before. ODDference brings that expertise into questions facing business and society.

It is also a place to meet people outside your usual circuit — creative leaders, business leaders, founders, policymakers, institutions and researchers — and turn those encounters into partners, collaborators and new ideas.

reasonsIntro.headline: Three reasons to be in the room.

reasons.title: See familiar problems through a different lens.
reasons.body: Creative professionals work with attention, emotion, experience, meaning and differentiation every day. ODDference brings that expertise into the questions business and society are facing now.

reasons.title: Connect with people outside your usual circuit.
reasons.body: ODDference brings together creative leaders, business leaders, founders, policymakers, institutions and researchers — putting potential clients, partners and collaborators in the same room who rarely meet at a single-industry conference.

reasons.title: Don't just hear the argument. Experience it.
reasons.body: If creative expertise is the point, the event itself should prove it. Artists and creative practitioners shape the spaces, scenography, performances, soundscape and other parts of how ODDference feels.

faq.question: What is ODDference?
faq.answer: A business conference where creative and cultural practitioners take the stage as experts rather than as entertainment, and business leaders, founders, policymakers and institutions come to learn from them. The 2026 edition ran over two days in central Helsinki with 25 speakers and more than 30 sessions.

faq.question: When and where is ODDference 2027?
faq.answer: Helsinki. The exact dates and venues are not confirmed yet — ticket holders hear first as each piece is settled. ODDference takes place alongside the wider ODDfest week across the city.

faq.question: Is the 2027 programme published?
faq.answer: Not yet. Blind Bird is deliberately sold before the programme is complete, which is why it is the lowest price the event will be sold at. The 2026 speakers and sessions above are there so you can judge what the event is actually like before the next line-up exists.

faq.question: Why buy before the programme is announced?
faq.answer: Price. Blind Bird is €299, Early Bird is €399 and the regular ticket is €499, each plus VAT 13.5%, so committing early is worth €200 against the full price. If you would rather wait for the line-up, the later tiers will be there.

faq.question: Can I buy an Early Bird or regular ticket now?
faq.answer: No. The tiers open one at a time, and Blind Bird is the current one. The other two are shown with their real prices so you can see what waiting costs. Card payment is not open yet — if you want a ticket now, email hello@oddfest.co and we will invoice you.

faq.question: Does an ODDference ticket include ODDfest?
faq.answer: ODDference 2027 takes place alongside ODDfest week, and the 2026 ODDference Pass included ODDfest access. What the 2027 ticket includes beyond ODDference itself is not settled yet — the ticket page is the source of truth for what each ticket covers.

faq.question: What language is ODDference in?
faq.answer: ODDference 2026 ran in English, with speakers from Finland, Denmark, Canada and the US. The working language for 2027 will be confirmed with the programme.

faq.question: Who is it for?
faq.answer: Business leaders, founders, business development and partnership people, organisational leaders, policymakers and institutions, and creative leaders working beyond the cultural sector. It is built for people who want perspectives and relationships outside their own industry.

faq.question: Can my organisation partner with ODDference?
faq.answer: Yes. Partnerships can be an idea, a question, expertise or resources — the ones that work improve the event for the people in the room rather than adding a logo. Use the partnership link on this page and tell us what you have in mind.

faq.question: I have a question that isn't answered here.
faq.answer: Email hello@oddfest.co — including anything about an existing ticket order.
